description: Land Title Settlement Department -   Notice calling for claims to property of intestate Kesbewa D/S Division and others
reasoning: This gazette content deals exclusively with land and property matters, specifically calling for claims to intestate property (property of deceased persons without a will) under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed land descriptions including village names, cadastral map numbers, parcel numbers, land extents, and certificate of title numbers. The content falls under land registrations and property ownership matters, which aligns perfectly with the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4).
